description: This source file defines the class SimpleDosingInstructions, which provides an implementation for dosing instructions within the OpenMRS medical record system. It includes methods for constructing, setting, retrieving, and validating dosing instructions related to drug orders, including dose, units, route, frequency, duration, and additional instructions.

classes.name: SimpleDosingInstructions
classes.description: A concrete implementation of DosingInstructions for simple medication dosing, supporting dose, route, frequency, duration, and additional instructions, along with methods for serialization, setting, validation, and retrieval of dosing data.

methods.name: getDosingInstructionsAsString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the dosing instructions formatted according to the specified locale.

methods.name: setDosingInstructions
methods.description: Sets the dosing instructions on a given DrugOrder object based on this SimpleDosingInstructions instance.

methods.name: getDosingInstructions
methods.description: Creates a new SimpleDosingInstructions instance populated with data from the specified DrugOrder, ensuring the dosing type matches.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the drug order’s dosing information, checking for missing or invalid fields and registering errors.

methods.name: getDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration of medication in integer.

methods.name: getAsNeeded
methods.description: Returns whether the medication is to be taken as needed.

methods.name: setAsNeeded
methods.description: Sets whether the medication is to be taken as needed.

methods.name: getAsNeededCondition
methods.description: Returns the condition for taking the medication as needed.

methods.name: setAsNeededCondition
methods.description: Sets the condition for taking the medication as needed.
